title: The derived tensor calculation before the lisse heart
statement: Fix D,l,E as in [def-real-tensor-pullback-comparison-data], X:Base D l hl and any normalized realization a:At D l hl E X [def-real-lisse-realization-data]. There is DerivedTensorRealization: a natural isomorphism from realization of the completed integral tensor to the published ordinary rational derived tensor of the two realizations, whose component on every pair of good representatives is exactly RealizationTensorCalculation.arrow. It extends to a raw rational natural isomorphism, whose integral component is the integral comparison conjugated by a.integral. Its ordinary scalar unit is multiplication c tensor b to c scalar(b), and its derived unit is exactly scalar counit, single-map comparison and that multiplication. No lisse tensor structure or degree-zero specialization is asserted.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; Stacks 07A4; original tensor proof steps 1-3, 6-7, excluding the lisse specialization

proof.text: Finite type over a field gives noetherian qcqs finite dimension and l invertible. Use the actual completion comparison chi, which is invertible on constructible pairs. Apply ordinary derived scalar extension to chi inverse and compose the ringed-topos scalar tensor constraint.

On every pair of good models the completion theorem identifies chi with the specified quotient pure-tensor map and zero shifted coordinate. Scalar extension sends flat-term K-flat models to flat-term K-flat models. The scalar counits give the endpoint identifications. The balanced map sends c tensor (x tensor y) to (1 tensor x) tensor (c tensor y), so these maps compute exactly RealizationTensorCalculation.arrow.

Conjugate by a.integral on integral objects. The scalar formula for the raw operations extends integral naturality to each fraction and then to sums; objects are unchanged. Multiplication c tensor b to c scalar(b) is invertible by inserting one. The flat-term K-flat single B[0] computes its derived unit via the displayed counit composite.
